definitions.explanation: Used when offering or inviting someone to do something.
Said when handing something to someone.

どうぞ⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
「⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧、⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。」「どうぞ。」
どうぞ⟦お{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
「⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。」「どうぞ。」

examples.english: Please be kind to me / Nice to meet you.

examples.japanese: ⟦おかし→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どうぞ。⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Here, have some sweets. Please take whichever you like.

notes:
どうぞ is a polite expression for inviting, offering, or giving permission.

TWO MAIN USES:
1. Invitation/permission: "please go ahead"
2. Offering: "here you are"

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どうぞ⟦お{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: Please come in
- どうぞ⟦お{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: Please go ahead (before me)
- どうぞ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧: Nice to meet you / Please treat me well
- どうぞ⟦ごゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧: Please take your time
- どうぞ⟦お{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: Please feel free to use it

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- どうぞ: polite invitation/offer
- ⟦どうか→どうか：09854_douka⟧: emphatic, pleading (please, I beg you)
- ⟦ぜひ→ぜひ：00911_zehi⟧: by all means, definitely (strong recommendation)

NOTE:
When handing something to someone, どうぞ alone is sufficient—no verb needed.
